description: This file defines the MediaPlayerClientBackend class, which implements the MediaPlayerClientBackendInterface for managing media playback, including creating media pipelines, controlling playback, and handling media sources within the Rialto client namespace.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientBackend
classes.description: A final class implementing media playback control functionalities, managing a media pipeline backend, and providing methods for media source attachment, playback control, and configuration within the Rialto client namespace.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerBackend
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media pipeline backend with specified media pipeline client and video requirements.

methods.name: isMediaPlayerBackendCreated
methods.description: Checks if the media pipeline backend has been successfully created.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the media pipeline backend.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from the media pipeline backend by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all media sources are attached.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specific type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if media data is available for a given status and request ID.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the media.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate of the media.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the video window.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment for streaming or playback.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Checks if the audio is muted.
